	We are seeking a skilled Backend Developer with proficiency in PHP Laravel, with some experience in DevOps, to join our dynamic team.

Backend Developer (PHP Laravel) Job at OneVERIFY Limited




        
    

        
        OneVERIFY Limited is a leading Nigerian technology company specializing in digital identity, verification, RegTech, AI, cybersecurity, and blockchain-based solutions. We build platforms that enable secure identity verification, AML/KYC compliance, fraud prevention, and data integrity for both government and private sector clients. Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize fostering a high-performance, inclusive, and compliant organizational culture.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Backend Developer (PHP Laravel)

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview
     

            
    




	We are seeking a skilled Backend Developer with proficiency in PHP Laravel, with some experience in DevOps, to join our dynamic team.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining our backend services, ensuring robust and scalable solutions that align with our project goals.


Key Responsibilities
Backend Development:


	Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Laravel
	Collaborate with frontend developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
	Implement and maintain APIs for seamless integration with various identity management systems.


System Integration:


	Work closely with other technology providers to integrate biometric and identity verification technologies into our platform.
	Ensure seamless integration and upscaling of the existing NIMC identity system.


Data Security & Efficiency:


	Implement robust security measures to protect sensitive data and prevent data leaks.
	Optimize backend systems for maximum efficiency and reliability.


DevOps:


	Assist in managing CI/CD pipelines to ensure smooth deployment processes.
	Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve the infrastructure to maintain system health and performance.


Documentation & Best Practices:


	Maintain comprehensive documentation of the backend codebase, APIs, and system architecture.
	Adhere to industry best practices for code quality, testing, and deployment.


Qualifications
Education:


	Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


Technical Skills:


	Proficiency in PHP and Laravel
	Experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g., Docker, Jenkins, Kubernetes).
	Strong understanding of RESTful API design and implementation.
	Familiarity with database technologies (SQL and NoSQL).
	Knowledge of security best practices in software development.


Experience:


	6 years of proven experience as a backend developer, with a strong portfolio of completed projects.
	Experience in identity management systems and biometric technologies is a plus.
	Experience with cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is desirable.


Soft Skills:


	Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
	Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
	Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Rig Supervisor - FPSO Platform Job at Scruples Resources Limited




        
    

        
        Scruples Resources Limited is a Premier Oil and Gas Support Services Provider. Established in Lagos, Nigeria, Scruples Resources Limited stands as a distinguished leader in the oil and gas industry. We specialize in delivering comprehensive support services, encompassing consultancy, logistics, procurement, engineering, manpower provisioning, and personnel training.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Rig Supervisor - FPSO Platform

Job Location: Delta
Employment Type: Contract

Main Functions
     

            
    




	Represents the company on a rig site to support the safe and efficient execution of well plans.
	Is the primary contact for rig and third-party personnel to ensure logistics for personnel, equipment, and services are appropriately organized and managed.


Responsibilities


	Responsible for communicating expectations regarding safety, security, health, and environment; provides guidance and supports managing Safety, Security, Health, and Environment (SSHE) events
	Responsible for communicating Operations Integrity Management System (OIMS) expectations on the rig site
	Monitors rig operations to provide feedback and input to the rig contractor to ensure well control procedures are properly followed, and emergency situations are appropriately managed
	Responsible for ensuring that safety, operational, environmental, security and other drills are conducted on site at specified frequencies
	Responsible for ensuring drilling and completion procedures are followed as approved and utilizes management of change processes if changes are required
	Orders and organizes logistics for services and equipment necessary to conduct drilling and completion operations efficiently
	Supports onsite surveillance requirements for the operation in areas such as kick detection, abnormal pressure detection, torque & drag, mud properties, and solids control efficiency
	Responsible for generation of accurate and adequate operations reports
	Interfaces with engineering and geology to ensure understanding of well objectives and procedural requirements


Skills and Qualifications


	Experience in rig supervisory or rig leadership roles for drilling and completion operations
	Experience working for a major Operator or Drilling Contractor
	Hold current certification for Well Control.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note


	Candidates must have at least 7 years of experience in the oil and gas industry.
	Any candidates who apply without this experience will have their CVs rejected immediately.
	Only qualified candidates who meet the requirements for this position will be contacted.
	Therefore, please ensure your CV aligns with the role before applying.
	Do not apply just for the sake of applying.
	Take your time, align your CV with the job requirements and specifications before submitting it. This is very important.
	Do not send your certificates, training certificates, NYSC certificate, SSCE certificate, or B.Sc. certificate. All these are needed.
	Only your CV is required.
	This role is strictly for NIGERIANS!!!! NO EXPATRIATE SHOULD APPLY, PLS!!!
